project.decision.note: production-reachable attribution does not change the evaluator reason

project.preference.note: production-reachable attribution does not change the evaluator reason

probeOnlyScoreImpact.note: probe-only cases produced no accepted proposal, so excluding them leaves precision unchanged; they do affect evidence validity and safety counters

degradedPrompts.note: the corpus fixes only assertionId and predicate for an active target, so ACTIVE FACTS renders text:null and the target carries a synthetic validFrom/seq (500/0). Production shows the stored value text and real times. Correction/retraction scores on these cases are a lower bound measured under a degenerate prompt, not a production measurement

recall.detail: recall is computed against the offline scorer, which applies its own clause-aligned unique-span rule. The production validator additionally requires the character after a whole-sentence quote to separate it, so some scorer acceptances are refused in production. Recall is an upper bound, not a guarantee

correctionCases.detail: correction/retraction cases target an active fact whose text is not in the corpus and whose validFrom/seq are synthetic placeholders. Production would show the stored text and real times. These scores are a lower bound under a degenerate prompt, not a production measurement

measurementCaveats.routeEnablement: no route was written; see routeState.routeEvidenceByPredicate

enablementTarget.note: any future route row must be keyed by this model digest and carry these evidence counters; counters are corpus-wide and a route is per scope, so a scope-specific row also requires that scope to be the evaluated population

routeState.note: no route state is read or written by this runner; recommendations are evaluator output only
